en-i-ih.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the vowel in the middle of each word.

en-r-l.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

en-th-s.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

fr-u-y.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the rounded vowel at the end of each word.

fr-an-on.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the nasal vowel at the end of each word.

fr-s-z.targetSoundFocus: Listen for the hiss or buzz in the middle or at the end of the word.
fr-s-z.caution: This set mixes a consonant between vowels with a word-final consonant. Natural voicing and duration can differ by position.

de-u-ue.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the stressed vowel in the first syllable.

de-i-length.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the stressed vowel. Its quality and duration both matter.

de-s-z.targetSoundFocus: Listen for the hiss or buzz between the vowels.

de-o-oe.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the stressed rounded vowel, even when the rest of the word changes.

es-tap-trill.targetSoundFocus: Listen for the tap or trill between the vowels.

es-p-b.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant, spoken after a pause.

es-stress.targetSoundFocus: Listen for the stronger syllable: the first or the second.
es-stress.caution: All starter words have two syllables. Compare stress position across words, not vowel identity or absolute loudness.

it-length.targetSoundFocus: Listen for a short or long consonant in the middle. Match the length pattern even when the consonant changes.
it-length.caution: This is feature matching across l, t and n, not matching one identical phoneme. Consonant and neighboring vowel timing both contribute.

it-f-v.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

it-p-b.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant. Other long consonants in the word are not the target.

zh-tone-1-4.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the pitch shape over the syllable: level or falling.

zh-tone-2-3.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the pitch shape over the syllable: rising or low.
zh-tone-2-3.caution: These are isolated citation tones. Third-tone sandhi and connected speech are separate tasks; absolute pitch across speakers is not the answer.

zh-tone-1-2.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the pitch shape over the syllable: level or rising.

pt-f-v.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

pt-s-z.targetSoundFocus: Listen for the hiss or buzz between the vowels.

pt-p-b.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

ru-hard-soft.targetSoundFocus: Listen for a hard or soft consonant quality. Match that quality even when the consonant changes.
ru-hard-soft.caution: This is plain versus palatalized feature matching across different consonants. Use initial-reference pairs with initial-X pairs, and final-reference pairs with final-X pairs, until a separate mixed-position task is explained.

ru-s-sh.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

ru-d-t.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

fr-e-e-open.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the vowel at the end of each word.
fr-e-e-open.caution: The declared northern reference variety keeps these vowel categories distinct. Only use voices that actually preserve the contrast.

fr-in-on.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the nasal vowel at the end of each word.

fr-an-in.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the nasal vowel at the end of each word.

fr-o-o-open.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the rounded vowel in the middle of each word.
fr-o-o-open.caution: Use reviewed northern-reference recordings retaining the quality difference. Natural timing can differ too; do not substitute a merged southern variety.

fr-b-p.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

fr-zh-sh.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the hiss or buzz at the beginning of each word.

fr-y-i.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the vowel in each word.

fr-y-oe.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the rounded vowel at the end of each word.

fr-u-oe.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the rounded vowel at the end of each word.

fr-e-oe.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the final vowel in each word.

fr-eh-eu-open.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the vowel immediately before the final French r.

fr-d-t.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

fr-g-k.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

fr-v-f.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

fr-b-v.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

fr-sh-s.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

fr-l-r.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the first consonant in each word.

fr-n-gn.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the nasal consonant at the end of each word.
fr-n-gn.caution: All reference and X targets are word-final. The conventional /ɲ/ category has regional realizations; do not assume one exact articulation or add a final schwa.

en-zh-j.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the consonant between the two vowel sounds.
en-zh-j.caution: All targets are medial. Treat /dʒ/ as one affricate category. Version/virgin requires the selected shared-final-schwa American readings; a final /ɪ/ in virgin or /ʃ/ in version is outside this pair’s declared form. Do not substitute leisure/ledger with /i/ in leisure.

en-foot-strut.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the vowel in the middle of each word.

en-ae-strut.targetSoundFocus: Listen to the vowel in the middle of each word.
